summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the Settings-scroll bug fix and the new Smart Batch Mode (Move vs Copy) feature. All 8 requested scenarios executed successfully at 390x800 mobile viewport against the preview URL. Notes were seeded directly into the localforage IndexedDB (IronRabbit -> notes store) to keep the flow deterministic. Every scenario (settings scroll, org scroll, toggle persistence, bulk Move + Undo, bulk Copy with/without suffix, Undo copy, Cancel from suffix dialog) passed and DB state was validated after each action.

test_results_per_scenario.1_settings_modal_scroll: PASS — DialogContent scrollable (scrollHeight 1138 > clientHeight 718), Clear-All-Data / Cancel / Save reachable at bottom.
test_results_per_scenario.2_organization_modal_scroll: PASS — Restore Defaults reachable, modal uses max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto.
test_results_per_scenario.3_smart_batch_toggle: PASS — Move active by default (indigo), clicking Copy switches highlight, choice persists to settings.dnd_prefs.smartBatchMode after modal reopen.
test_results_per_scenario.4_move_mode_bulk_move: PASS — MultiSelectBar label 'Move to…', notes moved from TestA to TestB in IndexedDB, Undo action restored both notes to TestA.
test_results_per_scenario.5_copy_mode_with_suffix: PASS — Label 'Copy to…' with copy icon, MoveTo title reads 'Copy 2 notes to…' and shows 'Smart Batch: Copy mode' hint, CopySuffixDialog visible, clicking Yes created 2 new notes in TestB with ' (copy)' suffix while originals remained in TestA.
test_results_per_scenario.6_copy_mode_no_suffix: PASS — Clicking 'No — keep exact same title' produced duplicates in TestB with identical titles (Alpha, Beta) and originals still in TestA.
test_results_per_scenario.7_copy_undo: PASS — Clicking Undo on sonner toast after copy removed the 2 newly-created copies from TestB; originals in TestA untouched.
test_results_per_scenario.8_cancel_from_suffix_dialog: PASS — Clicking Cancel closed dialog, no notes were created, MultiSelectBar remained visible for retry.

critical_code_review_comments: MultiSelectBar drives the entire bulk-copy/move flow but is only wired to the ICON-view NoteTile — list-view AccordionNoteItem does not expose selection UI. Consider parity so Copy/Move also works in list view.
NotesApp.jsx is ~1470 lines — consider splitting bulkMoveTo / bulkCopyTo / selection helpers into a dedicated hook (useBulkSelection.js) to keep the file under 700 lines.
bulkCopyTo does not batch DB writes; for large selections this makes N sequential awaits. Non-critical here (offline app, small N) but worth a Promise.all.

The Undo action on the Copy toast deletes copies by id, but if the user creates new notes in the interim the delete is still safe — however the toast has 6s duration; consider showing 'Undo' as an idempotent operation and disabling it after first click to avoid double-delete on rapid clicks.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/NotesApp.jsx (added missing data-testid="settings-btn" attribute on header Settings icon button so tests could locate it — matches the id spec expected by the request)
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 notes (id=test-note-1 'Alpha', id=test-note-2 'Beta') in category 'TestA' via direct IndexedDB write into IronRabbit->notes store before each scenario group. Notes deleted/reset between scenarios via indexedDB.clear.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com. localforage DB name is 'IronRabbit' (not 'iron-rabbit-db' as the request mentioned) with object stores: notes, settings, templates, files, metadata. Object stores use OUT-OF-LINE keys so IndexedDB store.put(value) requires a second key arg: store.put(note, note.id). data-testid="settings-btn" was added in this iteration. All Smart Batch Copy/Move flows verified end-to-end at 390x800 viewport.
rca of the issue: N/A — all scenarios passed. Settings-modal scroll fix (max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto) is effective; Smart Batch Mode (Move vs Copy) with CopySuffixDialog is fully functional including Undo for both paths.
